title: C&B & Gingivectomy – M.F
heading: C&B & Gingivectomy
body: At Younes Dental Clinic, this patient underwent a combined esthetic treatment with gingivectomy and custom veneers to achieve a balanced, natural-looking smile. Using advanced laser technology and digital planning, excess gum tissue was removed to create an ideal gum line, followed by precisely crafted veneers to correct discoloration, gaps, and imperfections. The result is a harmonious, radiant smile with long-lasting beauty and confidence.
